response: The bactericidal activity of 3 cutaneous/mucosal antiseptic solutions was assessed in the presence of interfering substances, with the goal of improving the NF EN 13727 European Standard. The study found that adapting this standard allowed for the evaluation of the 3 tested solutions, revealing that only one solution, CB, was bactericidal in dirty conditions. This research demonstrated the possibility of validating antiseptic choice in vitro, under current practice conditions, for the adjunctive treatment of skin and mucous membrane disorders, primarily of bacterial origin or with a potential for superinfection. Therefore, the improvement of the NF EN 13727 European Standard enabled a more accurate assessment of the bactericidal activity of antiseptic solutions in the presence of interfering substances.
